rules.statement: Minors are not bound by section 9 of the Partition Ordinance, and even if they were, the appellants have to face a significant difficulty as no other remedy is open to them except an action for damages.
rules.supporting_quote: "If minors are not bound by the section, it may be argued that the appellants have suffered no damage by the decree. If minors are bound by the section, then the appellants have to face a tether difficulty. Here is an enactment which, in creating new machinery for partition, bars all remedies-after a certain stage in the proceedings but one, which it indicates-an action for damages."
